name: Marumori Youko
source:
Shigeru's mother, a friend of Nao.

She tries not to interfere with her son's studies. She also takes care of him.

She is very devoted to his education.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/msb2.html]official site[/url]]
